lightweightMode.manualUpdate: return before range updates when true

video.imageVisibility: hide on rangeStartFrame; show after first asset frame is rendered

pause.particleSystems: pause all eleven explicit pause targets
pause.video: pause background video image unless lightweightMode

resume.particleSystems: play all eleven explicit pause targets
resume.video: resume background video image unless lightweightMode

lifecycle.clock: range events and two delay timers advance on Source update frames; absolute times use the nominal boundary and preserve authoritative rangeState edges
